_help.leagues: "all" or a list of codes, for example ["E0", "SP1", "I1"]. Codes are in the README.
_help.days_ahead: how many days of upcoming matches to predict (football-data.co.uk). API-Football free covers today + tomorrow.
_help.confident_threshold: a pick is CONFIDENT from this chance (0.50 = 50%)
_help.strong_threshold: a pick is STRONG from this chance (0.65 = 65%)
_help.value_min_edge: value bet when chance x odds is at least 1 + this (0.05 = 5% edge)
_help.value_min_prob: ignore value bets below this chance
_help.value_max_odds: ignore value bets above these odds
_help.bankroll: your betting bankroll, used for the Kelly stake (any currency)
_help.max_stake_pct: never stake more than this share of the bankroll on one bet
_help.acca_slips: how many accumulator slips per day
_help.acca_min_odds: a slip is finished when its total odds reach this
_help.acca_max_odds: a slip never goes above these total odds
_help.acca_leg_min_prob: only bets with at least this chance go into slips. Part 7 of the notebook compares 0.50, 0.55 and 0.60
_help.acca_leg_min_odds: skip legs with odds lower than this
_help.use_api_football: true = use API-Football for injuries, more fixtures and odds (needs the free key in .env)
_help.api_odds_budget: max single-match odds requests per run (free plan = 100 requests a day)
_help.utc_offset: your time zone for kickoff times. Nigeria = 1
_help.retrain_days: train the models again after this many days
_help.refresh_hours: download fresh results when the saved copy is older than this
_help.acca_markets: which bets go into the main accas: win, double_chance, over_under. These have old odds, so their profit is tested. For favourites to win only, use ["win"]
_help.banger_threshold: a pick is a BANGER from this chance (0.75 = 75%)
_help.top_n_per_league: how many matches of each league the Top favourites, Top goals, Top BTTS and Top corners sheets show
_help.strong_slips_min_prob: strong acca: favourites to win only, every leg at least this chance
_help.banger_slips_min_prob: banger acca: favourites to win only, every leg at least this chance. Not 0.75: those legs almost never reach 5 odds. Part 7 of the notebook has the test
_help.other_slips: how many other accas per day
_help.other_markets: which bets go into the other accas: btts, goal_lines (over 1.5, under 3.5), team_to_score (the favourite), handicap (underdog +1.5), fav_or_over (favourite or over 2.5), corners, corner_1x2, cards, shots. No old odds exist for these, so accuracy is tested but profit is not. Remove what you don't want
_help.acca_max_per_type: most bets of one type in one slip, so a slip is really mixed. Keep it at 2: higher gives fewer slips
_help.acca_leagues: "main" = the 22 main leagues, "all" = all 38, or a list of codes. In the backtest the 16 other leagues did clearly worse in accas, but their old odds are closing odds, which is a harder test
_help.injury_adjust: true = move the chance a little for missing players (about 0.3 points per player, the size measured on 6,248 past matches)
_help.internationals: true = also predict national teams (World Cup and Euro qualifiers, Nations League, AFCON, Copa America, Gold Cup, Asian Cup, friendlies). Needs the API-Football key: football-data.co.uk has no national teams
_help.intl_acca_min_prob: international acca: favourites to win only, competitive matches only (no friendlies), every leg at least this chance
_help.intl_in_picks: true = competitive national team matches (no friendlies) can also be in My picks, the strong and the banger acca. Accuracy tested, profit not
